definitions.Date: Feature date t; prediction made after the regular-session close.
definitions.Close: Provider Close at t in USD (not AdjustedClose).
definitions.VolumeRatio20: Volume[t] / mean(Volume[t-19:t+1]) - 1; 0 if mean volume is zero.
definitions.SMA5: Mean Close from t-4 through t inclusive (five observations).
definitions.SMA20: Mean Close from t-19 through t inclusive (twenty observations).
definitions.Return1D: Close[t] / Close[t-1] - 1; fraction, not percentage points.
definitions.Volatility20D: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the last 20 one-session returns through t; not annualized.
definitions.TargetDate: Next available source trading observation after t.
definitions.TargetClose: Close at TargetDate in USD; never an input feature.

notes: All five inputs use only observations dated on or before Date.
No scaling, fitting, splitting or evaluation is performed at this stage.
TargetClose and TargetDate must not be included as model input columns.
Exchange holidays are not filled; no official exchange-calendar check.
Windows crossing removed source observations are excluded, not bridged.
